dateline: BTS's first officially licensed book series — 'BTS Lyrics Inside' and 'BTS Recipe Book,' published via Hachette's Running Press imprint — arrived at US retailers Sept 15. The lyric breakdown book covers 10 songs from the 'Most Beautiful Moment in Life' era through 'Proof' with commentary from all seven members; the companion cookbook features 15 Korean dishes drawn from the group's variety shows. The ARIRANG World Tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá on Oct 2-3, followed by Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo through October.
heroHeadline: Day 4,843: BTS Debuts Official 'Lyrics Inside' and 'Recipe Book' Series
heroSubtitle: September 16, 2026 is Day 4,843 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The group's first officially licensed book series landed at US retailers Sept 15 via Hachette's Running Press imprint: 'BTS Lyrics Inside' (184 pages, $28) breaks down 10 songs — from the 'Most Beautiful Moment in Life' era through 2022's 'Proof' anthology, including 'Boy With Luv,' 'ON' and 'IDOL' — with full Hangul lyrics, romanization and commentary from RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook; its companion 'BTS Recipe Book' (256 pages, $30) features 15 Korean dishes from 'Run BTS!,' 'Bon Voyage' and 'In the Soop.' Both were first announced during June's FESTA. The ARIRANG World Tour now heads into its Latin American leg, opening in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2-3 before continuing to Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo.
